messages:
Ravi: FYI stream hiccup at slide 7, video froze for ~20s but audio stayed in sync. Anyone from streaming ops see what happened?
stream-bot: Incident logged AH-3467890123. Snapshot available s3://redwood-recordings/ah/3467890123/snapshots.zip
Cam: Jumping in — switched to failover encoder at +45s, backup looks stable. We have a ~25s hole in the main recording. Uploading partial now: https://internal.redwood/recordings/3467890123/part1.mp4
Lena: Root cause looks like a GPU texture upload stall from an animated slide. Disabled hardware overlay and restarted encoder. Patch applied: `systemctl restart encode && export LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1`.
Harper: Studio iso audio is fine. I can merge audio to the failover video and render a patched clip by 19:00 PT.
Maya: For Qs — I collected live questions that arrived during the gap into #all-hands-qa. Recommend answering top 2 live ones in a short 5-min follow-up at the end of the week and posting answers for the rest.
Ravi: Makes sense. Cam/Harper confirm ETA and deliverable? Also can someone ping support for any customer-facing asks?
Cam: Confirmed 19:00 PT patched clip + README. I'll post a support note with timestamps once upload completes.
Harper: Confirmed 19:00 PT deliverable: patched video and iso audio, plus brief note on edits.
Maya: I'll block 5 minutes in Friday's all-hands for the recap and add the top Qs to the talking points. DM me if there's a priority question.
Ravi: Action items: 1) Cam/Harper deliver patched clip by 19:00 PT, 2) Cam post support note with timestamps, 3) Maya reserve 5-min recap on Friday, 4) Lena to file postmortem with GPU driver logs.
Lena: Opened ticket STREAM-9184 with logs and mitigation.
Ravi: Thanks team. Ping me if anything changes. :slightly_smiling_face:
